name: LinkLens Micro-Copy for WooCommerce
author: linklenslabs

sections.description:
LinkLens Micro-Copy for WooCommerce lets you add short, trust-building messages exactly where customers hesitate — product pages, cart, checkout, and thank-you pages.

Instead of bulky badge images or long descriptions, Micro-Copy uses clean, readable text like:

  • Instant download
  • No recurring fees
  • Secure checkout
  • 30-day refund policy

Designed to stay out of the way while quietly reinforcing buyer confidence.

Features

  • Add one or more micro-copy message blocks per product
  • Place messages across product, cart, checkout, and thank-you pages
  • Optional icon + label per block
  • Optional per-product “View Docs / Learn More” button
  • Clean, lightweight output
  • No external requests, tracking, or license activation

Optional separate plugin

Additional add-ons may be available separately from the developer’s website.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install via the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Edit a WooCommerce product.
  4. Go to Product Data → Micro-Copy.
  5. Add your message and choose where it should appear.
sections.faq:
Will this slow down my site?

The plugin only outputs CSS and markup when a message (or docs button) is active on the current page. There are no frontend scripts and no external requests.

Does this use images or badge graphics?

No. Micro-Copy is text-based by design, which keeps it readable, accessible, and fast.

Can I show messages on cart and checkout pages?

Yes. Each message block allows you to choose one or more placements, including cart and checkout.

Does this require WooCommerce?

Yes. The plugin activates without errors if WooCommerce is missing, but features only appear when WooCommerce is active.
